description: Needs a free TronRelic account: calling it makes your app ask the user to sign in, then the call runs. List PUBLISHED blog posts, newest first, as lightweight summaries (no body). Use to discover what posts exist, find a recent post, or gather posts to summarise (each row carries "publishedAt", so you can select posts within a time window such as the last 48 hours yourself). Read-only; never mutates. Parameters: "page" (optional, 1-based, default 1) and "limit" (optional, default 20, clamped to 50). Returns { success, posts: [{ id, slug, title, tags, excerpt, publishedAt }], total, page, limit }, where "total" is the full published count for paging, "excerpt" is a short plain-text opening of the body you can read to pick the relevant post without fetching it, and each "id" can be passed to get-blog-post to read the full markdown body. Only published posts are ever returned.

limit.description: Page size (optional, default 20); clamped to the range 1-50.

page.description: 1-based page number (optional, default 1). Values below 1 are treated as 1.

name: list-blog-posts
title: List blog posts
